transcript: Speaker A: कविता जी, शादी के बाद इंग्लिश सीखना शुरू किया, क्यों? [Kavita ji, why did you start learning English after marriage?] Speaker B: शादी के बाद पति के ऑफिस पार्टी में गई थी। सब इंग्लिश में बात कर रहे थे। मैंने पूरी रात एक वर्ड नहीं बोला। घर आई, रोई नहीं, बट डिसाइड किया अब सीखना है। [After marriage, I went to my husband's office party. Everyone was speaking in English. I didn't speak a single word all night. I came home, didn't cry, but decided I have to learn now.] Speaker A: तो पूरी कहानी बताओ, शुरू से। [So tell the whole story, from the beginning.] Speaker B: मेरा नाम कविता है। राजस्थान के एक छोटे गांव से हूं। गांव में पढ़ाई की, हिंदी मीडियम, इंग्लिश का एक्सपोजर जीरो। फिर शादी हुई, नोएडा आ गई। पति अच्छा है, कुछ नहीं बोलता। पर उसके ऑफिस के लोग, उसकी फैमिली, सब इंग्लिश में बात करते हैं। मैं चुप रहती हूं जैसे मैं हूं ही नहीं। [My name is Kavita. I am from a small village in Rajasthan. I studied in the village, Hindi medium, zero English exposure. Then I got married and came to Noida. My husband is good, he doesn't say anything. But his office people, his family, everyone speaks in English. I stay quiet as if I don't even exist.] Speaker A: कब डिसाइड किया सीखना है? [When did you decide you have to learn?] Speaker B: पति की मम्मी ने एक दिन रिश्तेदार से बोला, "सुंदर है इसलिए शादी की।" सुना मैंने, चुभा। पर गलत नहीं थी वो। सुंदर होना काफी नहीं, बोलना भी आना चाहिए। फोन पे 'इंग्लिश सीखो' ऐप मिला। सोचा देखती हूं। ऐप खोला, सब हिंदी में समझाया था। पढ़ना नहीं है, वीडियो देखना है। [My husband's mother told a relative one day, "We married her because she is beautiful." I heard it, it hurt. But she wasn't wrong. Being beautiful is not enough, one must also know how to speak. I found the 'English Seekho' app on my phone. Thought I'd check it out. Opened the app, everything was explained in Hindi. No reading, just watching videos.] Speaker A: कहां से शुरू किया? [Where did you start?] Speaker B: 'जनरल इंग्लिश शो'। 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' पहला वीडियो। 1,65,000 लोग देख चुके थे। फिर 'अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें' - "My husband works at Infosys. We live in Noida. We recently got married." फिर गुड मैनर्स के इंग्लिश वर्ड्स - "Please, Thank you, Excuse me, It's nice to meet you." रात को पति सो जाता था, मैं फोन पे एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी। हिंदी में बोलती, वो इंग्लिश में कैसे बोलना है बताती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली, "गांव की है, तुझसे नहीं होगा।" कभी जज नहीं किया। [General English Show. 'Start conversation with Hello' was the first video. 1,65,000 people had watched it. Then 'Introduce your family' - "My husband works at Infosys. We live in Noida. We recently got married." Then English words for good manners - "Please, Thank you, Excuse me, It's nice to meet you." At night when my husband slept, I practiced with the AI coach on my phone. I spoke in Hindi, it told me how to say it in English. I spoke incorrectly 500 times, it corrected me 500 times. It never said, "You are from a village, you can't do it." It never judged.] Speaker A: कितने दिन लगे फर्क दिखने में? [How many days did it take to see a difference?] Speaker B: एक महीना। एक महीने में बेसिक कॉन्फिडेंस आ गया। अगली ऑफिस पार्टी में पति के बॉस की वाइफ ने पूछा, "Hi Kavita, how are you settling in?" मैंने बोला, "I'm doing well, thank you. We really like this city. The weather is so different from my hometown." बॉस की वाइफ, "Oh, where are you from?" मैंने बोला, "I'm from a small town in Rajasthan. It is very peaceful there, but I'm enjoying the city life now." पति दूर से देख रहा था। पहली बार वो expression देखा, प्राउड था मुझसे। और अब, अब ससुराल में चुप नहीं बैठती। गेस्ट आते हैं, मैं बात करती हूं। सास मम्मी जी कहती हैं, "कविता तुम भी आओ बाहर।" पहले कहती थीं अंदर रहना। [One month. In one month, basic confidence came. At the next office party, my husband's boss's wife asked, "Hi Kavita, how are you settling in?" I said, "I'm doing well, thank you. We really like this city. The weather is so different from my hometown." Boss's wife, "Oh, where are you from?" I said, "I'm from a small town in Rajasthan. It is very peaceful there, but I'm enjoying the city life now." My husband was watching from afar. For the first time I saw that expression, he was proud of me. And now, now I don't sit quietly at my in-laws' house. When guests come, I talk. My mother-in-law says, "Kavita, you also come out." Earlier she used to say stay inside.] Speaker A: जो लड़की अभी गांव से शहर आई है, उससे क्या बोलोगी? [What would you say to a girl who has just come from a village to the city?] Speaker B: गांव से आना कमजोरी नहीं है। इंग्लिश ना आना कमजोरी नहीं है, चुप रहना कमजोरी है। 'इंग्लिश सीखो' ऐप डाउनलोड करो। 'जनरल इंग्लिश शो' खोलो। 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' से स्टार्ट करो। एआई कोच से रोज 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करो। एक महीने में तुम वही नहीं रहोगी। सुंदर होना काफी नहीं, बोलना आना चाहिए। और बोलना सीखा जाता है। [Coming from a village is not a weakness. Not knowing English is not a weakness, staying silent is a weakness. Download the 'English Seekho' app. Open 'General English Show'. Start with 'Start conversation with Hello'. Practice for 15 minutes daily with the AI coach. In one month, you won't be the same. Being beautiful is not enough, you must know how to speak. And speaking can be learned.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और 'इंग्लिश सीखो' ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the 'English Seekho' app.]
summary: A woman shares her journey of learning English after feeling excluded at her husband's office parties and hearing her mother-in-law say she was only married for her looks. She explains how the 'English Seekho' app helped her gain confidence through video lessons and AI practice. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
